education.major: Computer Science & Engineering with specialization in AI & Machine Learning

responsibilities: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product teams to translate business requirements into data-driven solutions using statistical modeling and machine learning.
Clean, preprocess, and normalize structured tabular and unstructured text datasets for model consumption.
Build, tune, validate, and benchmark predictive ML models using Python, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow.

projects.name: Synapse
projects.title: Custom LLM/RAG Vector Engine
projects.tagline: Sub-millisecond Offline Vector Search & Dual Embedding Pipeline
projects.problem_statement: Commercial vector databases introduce external network latency, cloud dependency, and resource overhead for offline or edge AI applications.
solution_and_architecture: Implemented Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs and KD-Trees from scratch without external vector DB dependencies.
Engineered a live /benchmark endpoint comparing query latencies across index structures, proving sub-millisecond search times.
Architected an offline-first RAG pipeline exposing 14 modular REST API endpoints for vector indexing, document ingestion, and local LLM Q&A via Ollama.
Designed a dual embedding pipeline supporting 16-dimensional demo vectors for rapid visualization and 768-dimensional high-fidelity semantic embeddings using Ollama's nomic-embed-text.

projects.name: Kore Logic
projects.title: AI Career & Learning Platform
projects.tagline: Full-Stack Career Mentorship & Skill Matching Engine with Sub-200ms RAG
projects.problem_statement: Students lack personalized career roadmaps and real-time gap analysis between their current skill profile and live internship requirements.
solution_and_architecture: Built a complete full-stack platform exposing 19 REST API endpoints connected to a normalized PostgreSQL database schema of 10 core entity tables via SQLAlchemy.
Constructed a high-speed RAG pipeline using LangChain, ChromaDB, and GPT-4o powering an interactive mentor chatbot with sub-200ms query latency.
Implemented a real-time cosine-similarity matching engine over skill embeddings to calculate personalized internship 'Match Percentage' scores.

projects.name: Aura Tender
projects.title: AI Procurement Compliance Platform
projects.tagline: Multimodal Document Analysis & Zero-Shot Compliance Verification
projects.problem_statement: Manual procurement compliance audits of hundred-page tender documents are tedious, error-prone, and take dozens of hours per proposal.
solution_and_architecture: Built an AI-driven compliance evaluation platform automating multimodal document analysis, cutting manual review effort by over 80% per tender.
Deployed a zero-shot Gemini 1.5 Pro extraction pipeline that systematically cross-references bidder evidence against compliance checklists, saving multiple hours per document.
Designed a human-in-the-loop review workflow that automatically flags ambiguous documents or clauses for manual verification, preserving full auditability.

metrics_and_highlights.effort_reduction: Cuts manual review effort by over 80% per tender

projects.name: FasalWatch
projects.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Climate Resilience System
projects.tagline: Thermal Stress Detection & Mother-Tongue SMS Farming Advisories
projects.problem_statement: Extreme heatwaves and microclimate shocks damage smallholder agricultural yields before farmers can adapt.
solution_and_architecture: Constructed an autonomous multi-agent pipeline using the Strands Agents SDK to process 7-day microclimate weather forecasts.
Detects crop-stage thermal stress anomalies and automatically synthesizes low-cost farm interventions.
Translates advisories into Grade-5 mother-tongue languages via Amazon Translate and dispatches them over basic SMS via Amazon SNS.

metrics_and_highlights.reach: Basic SMS delivery for non-smartphone farmers

projects.name: EconoCausal
projects.title: Dynamic Pricing & Promotional Allocation via Causal AI
projects.tagline: Double Machine Learning & Linear Programming for Counterfactual Uplift
projects.problem_statement: Standard correlational ML models misallocate promotional discounts by coupon-bleeding on organic customers who would convert anyway.
solution_and_architecture: Deployed Double/Debiased Machine Learning (LinearDML & CausalForest) with Neyman orthogonality to estimate Individual Treatment Effects (ITE).
Formulated and solved knapsack promotional budget allocation across pricing tiers ($0, $10, $20) using the SciPy HiGHS Linear Programming solver.
Constructed interactive DAG inspection and DoWhy refutation tests (placebo treatments, random unobserved confounders) for auditability.

metrics_and_highlights.causal_framework: Double Machine Learning (DML) via Microsoft DoWhy & EconML
metrics_and_highlights.optimization: SciPy HiGHS LP Solver for promotional spend
metrics_and_highlights.validation: DoWhy Refutation Placebo & Data Subset Tests
